test_signing_key_note: FIXED TEST KEY, published on purpose. Never use it for anything real.

01-valid.description: A session as the recorder writes it: 2 tool calls, a signed Stop checkpoint, 1 tool call, a signed SessionEnd checkpoint.

02-broken-prev-hash.description: seq 3 has a prev_hash that is not seq 2's receipt_hash (last hex digit changed). Its receipt_hash and every later receipt were recomputed and the checkpoints re-signed with the real key, so nothing but the chain link is wrong.

errors.message: ERR_CHAIN at seq 3 (line 3): prev_hash does not match the previous receipt

03-forged-checkpoint-signature.description: The Stop checkpoint at seq 5 carries a well-formed 128-hex Ed25519 signature over its receipt_hash made with a different key; signature.verify_key and signer still name the real key.

04-unsigned-checkpoint.description: The SessionEnd checkpoint at seq 8 was written while the remote signer was down: no signer or signature, signer_error "SignerError" in the hashed body. The Stop checkpoint at seq 5 is signed.

errors.message: ERR_UNSIGNED at seq 8 (line 8): checkpoint has no signature: the recorder's signer failed when it was sealed ('SignerError')
